Every reaction in a relationship is a mirror of something unresolved within you. Your partner, your children, your parents or extended family. Each one reveals unconscious patterns, thoughts, and beliefs you have carried from the past into the present moment.
Career & Financial Wealth?
When your job becomes a part of your identity, losing it can feel like losing yourself.
The fear around career and finances  stems from survival. It is tied to the story the mind has created about who you are, your worth, and what happens if it all disappears.

The body memorizes what the mind repeatedly lives in.
